title: CurriculumAuthoringRun
description: Idempotent staged agent curriculum workflow for a specific draft and exact accepted source versions.

institution_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Institution in the owning institution.

target_course_draft_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized CourseDraft in the owning institution.

expected_draft_revision.description: Draft compare-and-swap revision from approved plan.

platform_job_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution, job_kind course_import and target type CurriculumAuthoringRun.

requested_by_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Principal in the owning institution.

agent_principal_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Principal in the owning institution.

source_extraction_run_ids.x-reference-scope: Every source is sealed, authorized and belongs to same institution.

request_fingerprint.description: Canonical authorized brief, exact extraction set, target and expected revision.

brief_object_id.description: Sealed purpose, teaching brief, allowed provider and privacy constraints.
brief_object_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and Platform evidence purpose. Input brief is exact and owned by target CourseDraft; an immutable scoped run copy may be linked once the run exists.

stage_manifest_object_id.description: Latest sealed candidate or apply checkpoint manifest.
stage_manifest_object_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution. Platform purpose evidence and exact owner CurriculumAuthoringRun. Resolve actual object version and digest before use.

approved_plan_digest.description: Exact reviewed candidate selection and target draft fingerprint.

approved_by_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Principal in the owning institution.

revision.description: Expected run revision used by stage and approval commands.

x-invariants: Every selected source and owner effect rechecks current rights and scope.
Candidate and approved plan manifests are protected immutable StorageObjects.
The authoring run cannot publish courses or create offerings, attempts, learner evidence or official grades.
Apply must be selection-closed and bound to exact sealed inputs and draft revision.
